title: Monitoring choices
decision: A signed-in user's not-found answer on any shop route counts as a cross-tenant attempt, so a former member or a mistyped link raises it too; metrics are held in the process's memory and guarded by a bearer token; the text of an exception is never logged; a log line may carry only a fixed list of identifier fields
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 47
rationale: The operations document names the signals and that logs hold no personal data, not how either is ensured
